options.vulkanfish.title: Vulkanfish Settings
options.vulkanfish.fullbright.tooltip: Brightens dark areas (caves, night) with soft fill light. Shading, ambient occlusion and sun shadows are kept.
options.vulkanfish.raytracing.tooltip: Torches, lanterns and other light sources cast real shadows (hardware ray tracing). Off: vanilla block light.
options.vulkanfish.taa.tooltip: Smooth edges and stable details over several frames.
options.vulkanfish.rayReconstruction.too: NVIDIA's AI denoiser (DLSS 4) instead of DLAA: keeps torch shadows clean while moving. Needs DLSS and ray tracing. Expensive at native resolution (about 20 ms at 2560x1600 on an RTX 5070 Laptop).
options.vulkanfish.frameGen.tooltip: NVIDIA's AI frame generation (DLSS 4): shows up to 5 generated frames between two rendered ones. Needs an RTX 40/50 GPU (6x: RTX 50) and works best at 60+ rendered FPS without VSync.
options.vulkanfish.dlss.tooltip: NVIDIA's AI anti-aliasing (DLSS 4, transformer model) instead of the built-in TAA. NVIDIA RTX only; otherwise TAA is used.
options.vulkanfish.lodDistance.tooltip: How far the simplified far field reaches. Within your render distance the normal world is shown.
options.vulkanfish.lodDetail.tooltip: Largest allowed size of a far-field voxel on screen. 1 px: no visible loss of detail. Larger: less GPU time and memory.
options.vulkanfish.lodBudget.tooltip: GPU time per frame for generating new far-field areas (more is used automatically when the GPU would otherwise idle).
options.vulkanfish.seed.saved: Seed saved - the far field is generated if it matches the server.
options.vulkanfish.seed.none: No seed: far field only from visited chunks.
